messages:
incident-bot: Pager triggered: PD-INC-8271 — severity: P1 — gpu-host-07 unreachable, kubelet NotReady, large frac of inference pods pending. paging oncall.

Jamie (SRE): acked. I'm on it. pinging infra for host access. @Lee

Lee (Infra): got it, I'm pulling console logs and checking node health now.

Jamie (SRE): quick summary from metrics: frontend error rate for /v1/generate -> 5% 503s over last 2m, tail latency spikes. Affected: hosted-inference-prod, dedicated-pool-2 fallbacks tripped.

Noah (CS): FYI customer impact: 2 enterprise customers reported degraded inference 10m ago; tickets #4529 #4531.

Lina (Runtime): seeing KV cache misses and long queue depth on redis-proxy for that node's shard. Pods on gpu-host-07: 42 running, 13 crashloop/pending.

Lee (Infra): console shows host kernel oops before kubelet disconnect:
```
[ 1234.567890] Kernel panic - not syncing: Fatal exception in interrupt
[ 1234.568901] CPU: 1 PID: 0 Comm: swapper/1 Not tainted
[ 1234.569012] RIP: 0010:0x7f8c3a2b
```
Will try to request BMC power cycle. ETA ~3m.

Jamie (SRE): good, cordon node and drain as soon as possible to move pods off. Lina, please prepare model fallbacks so we don't send new long requests to that host.

Lina (Runtime): starting rollout of routing-policy to avoid gpu-host-07 and promote gpu-host-09 as backup. Applying temporary route overrides: `route set --exclude-host gpu-host-07 --promote gpu-host-09`.

oncall-rotation: @Jamie handing off if you need to escalate to Tier2 hardware. I'm available for follow-up.

Lee (Infra): BMC power cycle sent. Host is rebooting now (IPMI cmd queued). Monitoring console.

Jamie (SRE): draining in parallel: `kubectl cordon gpu-host-07 && kubectl drain gpu-host-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=30`
Some pods stuck in Terminating due to local filesystem mounts — Lina can we force reschedule for inference workers?

Lina (Runtime): forcing eviction for stuck pods with `kubectl delete pod --force --grace-period=0` on those 5 pods. Rescheduling to gpu-host-09 and gpu-host-11.

Noah (CS): ETA to restore customer-facing success rates? Customers are asking for timeline.

Jamie (SRE): initial mitigation: expect gradual recovery in 4-8 minutes after nodes are drained and fallback routing completes. We'll post updates every 5.

Lee (Infra): host is back to POST, kernel booted but dmesg shows repeated GPU driver errors before panic. Marking host for hardware investigation. Flagging as potentially flaky GPU.
`/var/log/dmesg` snippet: "nvidia: GPU reset failed, engine hung"

Lina (Runtime): traffic now draining from gpu-host-07, 80% of pods rescheduled. Service error rate down from 5% to 1.2% in last 60s. Continuing to monitor model quality regressions due to fallback quantized variant.

Jamie (SRE): note — automatic fallback increased token cost by ~8% for affected requests; finance FYI if sustained.

Noah (CS): telling customers: we see a transient host failure; requests are routing to fallback capacity and we're monitoring. ETA ~10m for full stabilization.

Lee (Infra): I will cordon the host permanently from the pool until hardware root cause triaged. Creating a hardware ticket to RMA if needed.

Lina (Runtime): running regression checks on a small prompt set against new hosts; no major quality deltas observed so far. Will escalate if any anomalies >0.5% BLEU/regression threshold.

oncall-rotation: Jamie handing off to Lina for post-mortem and follow-up with infra. Lina, you're primary for the next 8h. @Lina please confirm.

Lina (Runtime): confirmed. I'll own the RCA and the customer-impact summary for ops-comms. Will include timeline and mitigation playbook.

Jamie (SRE): closing the pager once node is isolated and customer rates stable. Leaving notes: PD-INC-8271 — root cause suspected GPU driver/hardware panic; immediate mitigation: cordon+drain, IPMI power cycle, promote fallbacks. Next actions: hardware RMA, kernel/driver debug, add additional healthcheck before scheduling.

incident-bot: Pager PD-INC-8271 acknowledged by Jamie (SRE). Escalation canceled.

Noah (CS): thanks team — I'll update customers and close the open CS tickets with the current mitigation summary. :thumbsup:

Lina (Runtime): creating follow-up ticket for routing policy automation to detect node kernel oops and preemptively remove from rotation. Assigning to runtime infra.

Jamie (SRE): good work. Will add logs and timeline to postmortem doc. Logging thread as closed but keeping an eye. :white_check_mark:
